stableActor: Reuse disabled subject and dedicated tenant; no per-run Auth create/delete
completionAccumulation: tenant+actor+activity aggregates persist. A new scenarioId cannot turn an already-completed activity into INCOMPLETE.
betweenScenarios: Prefer readback-only reuse; from-empty scenarios require separately approved exact cleanup of test-owned attempt/progress IDs after dependency inventory
nodeProgressPredicate: no other retained Activity attempts depending on aggregate
pageLessonProgress: If present derive existing FK/reference graph and delete/recompute only approved test-owned rows; never broad delete or arbitrary boolean reset
order: Disable scope -> verify no inflight operation -> dependency audit -> preserve safe evidence -> child rows then parent aggregate rows in one reviewed transaction -> independent readback
registryCleanup: Close/expire scope; retain safe operation receipt for reconciliation; never use registry deletion to reset domain truth
retire: Default retain actor banned/profile inactive/membership suspended. Hard Auth/tenant deletion is not approved: existing FK ON DELETE CASCADE relationships exist. Must enumerate all effects and use separately approved non-cascading retirement plan.
